headline: U.S. commits $7.95M to Youth Ambassadors exchange programs across the Americas
summary: The State Department's FY 2026 Youth Ambassadors grant will fund immersive leadership and cultural exchange programs for teens across the Western Hemisphere.
caption:
🌍 OPPORTUNITY WATCH — United States / Global

The U.S. Department of State has announced up to $7.95 million in FY 2026 funding for the Youth Ambassadors Program — immersive leadership and cultural exchange experiences that bring together teenagers from across the Americas to build skills, confidence, and community.

Every investment like this widens the circle of opportunity. At COFY, we believe every young person — including youth with developmental delays and special needs — deserves the chance to lead, learn, and belong.
